I've selected the **seed** candidate as the final delivered BIM (no revision was applied).

## Summary

**Investigation performed:** I focused on the southeast space (`BottomRightOffice`/`Corridor` jog) per the local worker observation, which claimed a complex interior polyline with two separate door openings around original pixels x≈485–610, y≈700–875.

**What I found:**
- I re-read the 1f_view.png east-side dimension chain (540/1500/2380/1200/740/4800/1540/1600/5700mm, summing exactly to 20000mm) and mapped cumulative offsets to world y. Two of the internal ticks (y≈14.38 and y≈7.3) landed almost exactly on the seed's existing `TopRightRoom`/`MeetingRoomBig`/`Corridor` jog boundaries, and the "1600" segment matched the seed's `D_E_Side` door width/position (5.7–7.3m) precisely.
- Close-up crops of the cited pixel region showed a door swing arc and wall-jog pattern consistent with the door frame/reveal for `D_Corridor_BottomRightOffice` and the existing corridor jog corner — not clear independent evidence of a second, differently-shaped room boundary or a genuinely new second door as the worker's polyline implied.
- I was not able to finish precisely re-calibrating pixel↔world y (top/bottom wall anchor pixels) before the time budget ran low, so the exact sub-metre placement of that jog corner (nominally x=5.82, y=3.314 in the seed) remains **not independently re-verified to the same rigor as the x=14.38/7.3 checks**.

**Decision:** Since the worker's alternative geometry was not corroborated (it appears to conflate door-frame/swing linework with room walls, and contradicts the dimension-chain cross-check), and I could not complete a fully confident replacement geometry within the remaining budget, I retained the seed geometry rather than applying an unsupported change, per the "if a revision cannot be supported, retain the seed with an honest limitation" instruction.

**Unresolved / honestly flagged:**
- Southeast jog corner exact pixel calibration (top/bottom wall reference pixels) was not finished — the y=3.314 boundary and the two door hosts there are plausible but not freshly pixel-verified in this session.
- Seed's pre-existing unresolved items stand: door swing directions/states unknown; wall thickness/offsets not surveyed via `check_wall_dimensions`.
- No `check_openings` review was run in this session (time-constrained); opening review status remains "not_reviewed" per the delivery record — this is not claimed as verified.
- Facade/opening reviews and calibrated overlay inspection were not performed this session; only static image crops and the dimension-chain arithmetic were used.

Final candidate: **seed** (unchanged), selected via `finish_bim`.
